contract_constraints.description: data must contain field values matching collection schema data types
contract_constraints.assertion: data field types match collection schema

contract_constraints.description: filter must be a valid boolean expression string
contract_constraints.assertion: filter is a valid boolean expression

contract_constraints.description: id must match the collection primary key type (Int64 or VarChar)
contract_constraints.assertion: id type matches collection primary key type

contract_constraints.description: REST insert has no fixed row-count limit; request size is bounded by payload-size limits, not by an entity count
contract_constraints.assertion: no fixed upper bound on len(data); inserts of any row count that fits the request payload are accepted (HTTP 200)

contract_constraints.description: Vector dimension must match collection dimension
Collection must exist and be loaded; if autoID is disabled, primary key must be provided
contract_constraints.assertion: collection exists AND is loaded AND (autoID OR primary key provided)

contract_constraints.description: Insert returns insert count and IDs on success
Delete returns 400 on invalid filter expression
Get entities returns 400 if id type mismatches collection schema
